blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over P1 trillion of the allocations for the 2027 national budget are red flags or suspected “pork,” the People’s Budget Coalition (PBC) told the Senate on Monday. The PBC shared its analysis of the National Expenditure Program (NEP) and the House General Appropriations Bill (HGAB) during the Senate finance committee’s consultation with civil society organizations. “Lampas P1 trillion pesos po ang nakita naming red flags sa 2027 budget: P210 billion sa soft pork sa anyo ng patronage-driven ayuda, P695 billion sa hard pork which are politicized infrastructure, and P112 billion in shadow pork o yung unprogrammed appropriations,” PBC co-convenor […]...
